releaseData.title: Assimilation Loops LP
releaseData.description: My fourth album of 2025! Assimilation Loops is the remix album of the Miscegenation Loops LP released in March. Each new mix expands on the original version with more sonic exploration of mixing club music with dub techno and a smattering of other genres while adding politically charged samples from the likes of James Baldwin and Michael Parenti.
